    Classification of simple finite mesh modules #

    For a finite mesh category with local vertex endomorphism rings, the categorical radical of each finite representable is its unique maximal submodule. Its cokernel is the mesh simple at that vertex, and these exhaust the simple objects of the finite-dimensional module category.
